load_fever_metric: load the FEVER metric module using evaluate.load with the metric name fever
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the loaded FEVER metric module
run_fever_evaluation: run the FEVER metric evaluation on predictions and references via the loaded module
compute_fever_score: compute the FEVER metric score by calling the compute method on the loaded module
test_fever_metric: test the FEVER metric module loaded via evaluate.load for correctness and output format
